conditions.summary: Begin development within three years from 15 June 2026
conditions.source_quote: The development to which this permission relates must be begun no later than three years from the date of this decision notice.

conditions.summary: Carry out development in accordance with approved drawings and documents: Site Location Plan, Existing and Proposed Ground Floor and Basement Plan, Existing and Proposed Section A-A, Existing and Proposed Section B-B, Basement Impact Assessment dated 18th April 2026, & Fire Statement dated 18th April 2026
conditions.source_quote: The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the approved drawings and documents: Site Location Plan, Existing and Proposed Ground Floor and Basement Plan, Existing and Proposed Section A-A, Existing and Proposed Section B-B, Basement Impact Assessment dated 18th April 2026, & Fire Statement dated 18th April 2026.

conditions.summary: Carry out basement works in accordance with mitigation measures in Basement Impact Assessment dated 18th April 2026
conditions.source_quote: The basement works hereby approved shall be carried out in accordance with the mitigation measures set out in the Basement Impact Assessment dated 18th April 2026.
